facts.text: Under the Blue and Gold Opportunity Plan, California residents who qualify for financial aid and whose families earn less than $80,000 receive gift aid covering system-wide tuition and fees.

sources.title: When will I receive the Blue and Gold award? | Financial Aid
sources.quote: The Blue and Gold Opportunity Plan promises to provide enough gift aid to cover system-wide tuition and fees if you are a California resident who qualifies for financial aid and your family earns less than $80,000 a year.
